notes.title: After 4 years, the Three Kingdoms Simulator has been greatly updated
notes.content:
Dear Three Kingdoms Simulator players,

Time flies, and in the blink of an eye, we have been separated for four years. Over the past four years, we've been working hard to improve and refine our game to reward our players for their support and love. Today, we are very excited to announce that Three Kingdoms Simulator is about to receive a major update, which will bring players a richer gaming experience, let's look back on those familiar historical moments and feel the style of the Three Kingdoms Heroes again!

Here are the key takeaways from this update:

1. New map system: We have upgraded the original map and added some interactive locations, so that players can feel the geography of the Three Kingdoms period more realistically in the game. These interactive locations include places of interest, facilities, and more, where players can engage in various activities such as tours, trades, and more. At the same time, we've also optimized the loading speed of the map, so that players can explore more smoothly in the game. Now, players can easily move around the map and quickly find places of interest.

2. Richer settings: In this update, we have added the auto-generation function of the Legend of the Commander and the computer mutiny function. The auto-generation function of the general's biography can automatically generate the biography of each military general according to the player's performance and choices in the game, so that players can have a deeper understanding of the story of each military general. The computer mutiny feature adds to the randomness and sense of history of the game, and players need to be constantly vigilant about the changes in computer power and make corresponding strategies. These new settings make the game more varied, more challenging and fun.

3. System optimization: We have comprehensively optimized the game system, which reduces many difficulties in playing and makes the gameplay process smoother. Players have a greater impact on the course of history, and gameplay such as the Messenger Interception gameplay, which was difficult to use before, can now be used calmly, so that players can influence the general trend of the world single-handedly. We've also tweaked and balanced the various mechanics in the game to make the game more fair and playable. Now, players have more freedom to choose their own development path and achieve their goals.

4. Optimized game interface: We have fully optimized the game interface to make it more beautiful and concise. We've redesigned the layout of the interface to make the modules clearer and easier for players to find what they need. At the same time, we have also optimized the operation of the game to make it easier and more enjoyable for players to operate in the game. Players can now perform a variety of actions with simple taps and drags for a smoother gaming experience.
